Bruma.position: Cyrodiil's northernmost city, in the Jerall foothills where the Silver Road meets the snow

connections.path: the north gate and the garrison checkpoint
south, two days rising into snow, toward the Imperial City
west along the Jerall foothills toward Chorrol
the shepherds contour east, half a day up

Bruma.description: Black timber halls with turf roofs weighted in stone, smoke-holes venting into a sky that is grey nine months a year, and Nord surnames filling the Imperial tax-rolls three names deep. The Counts of Bruma have sworn to White-Gold for four hundred years and every one of them has been buried under a Nord cairn. The Legion garrison sits astride the north gate, watching the pass.

The Shanty Below the Walls.position: A sprawl of tents, cart-shelters, and lean-tos against Bruma's south wall, grown over the winter from the merchant queue the pass closure stranded.

connections.path: through the south gate, a few minutes walk

The Shanty Below the Walls.description: Canvas gone grey with woodsmoke, cart-wheels dug in as tent-poles, a communal fire pit that never quite goes out. What started as a queue of merchants waiting out a closed pass has become something closer to a town nobody planned -- families, drovers, a few Khajiit caravaners who ran out of road. Thin, but not yet broken.
